item.text: {"classification":"supported_negative","mechanism":"Authorization requires the token to exactly equal \"ALLOW:\" plus the supplied user; merely matching the audited prefix has no authorization effect.","evidence":["Source: authorize(\"mallory\", \"ALLOW:alice\") evaluates token == \"ALLOW:mallory\" as false.","Probe receipt: the accepted-shape token \"ALLOW:alice\" used for user \"mallory\" produced authorized=false."],"uncertainty":"The supplied source and receipt demonstrate rejection of this mismatched-user token only; other behaviors were not probed."}
